text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That comes to an even ninety-nine! The
question
is, of what?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The answer is the total number of
coconuts I split
with my bare hands
during summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And since you got it wrong, your
punishment is to
walk all the way back
to the academy! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I race to the bus before it can leave
without me.
